title: Payment Arrangement Schedule A — Arrangement Kinds and Entry Requirements
content:
# Payment Arrangement Schedule A — Arrangement Kinds and Entry Requirements

Lakeshore Power & Light offers seven kinds of Payment Arrangement. Each kind is open only to the customer class and on the bases shown below; a kind is enrolled only where every requirement in its row is met on the enrollment date.

## A.1 Customer class, hardship bases and season

| Arrangement kind | Customer class | Hardship basis required | Active budget billing plan on the same agreement required | Electric space heating required | Senior basis (minimum age of the residential account holder) | Current income qualification required | Enrollment window |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Payment Extension | Residential or business | No | No | No | None (0) | No | Any time |
| Short-Term Installment Plan | Residential | No | No | No | None (0) | No | Any time |
| Standard Deferred Payment Agreement | Residential | No | No | No | None (0) | No | Any time |
| Extended Deferred Payment Agreement | Residential | Yes | Yes | No | None (0) | No | Any time |
| Winter Protection Plan | Residential | No | No | Yes | 65 | No | 11-01 through 03-31 |
| Arrearage Management Program | Residential | No | No | No | None (0) | Yes | Any time |
| Commercial Deferred Payment Agreement | Business | No | No | No | None (0) | No | Any time |

A hardship basis is either an active medical certification on the agreement or a current income qualification. For the Winter Protection Plan the senior basis and a current income qualification are alternatives: the plan needs electric space heating and either of the two. A senior age of 0 means the kind has no senior basis.

## A.2 Arrears age, service length, disconnection and channel

| Arrangement kind | Minimum age of the oldest unpaid bill past its due date | Minimum months since the agreement's start date | May be enrolled on a disconnected agreement | Online self-service enrollment without an agent |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Payment Extension | 0 days (no minimum) | 0 (no minimum) | No | Yes |
| Short-Term Installment Plan | 0 days (no minimum) | 0 (no minimum) | Yes | Yes |
| Standard Deferred Payment Agreement | 0 days (no minimum) | 0 (no minimum) | Yes | No |
| Extended Deferred Payment Agreement | 0 days (no minimum) | 0 (no minimum) | Yes | No |
| Winter Protection Plan | 0 days (no minimum) | 0 (no minimum) | Yes | No |
| Arrearage Management Program | 90 days | 6 | No | No |
| Commercial Deferred Payment Agreement | 0 days (no minimum) | 6 | Yes | No |

## Notes to Schedule A

- A kind marked "No" for a disconnected agreement is available only while the agreement is active or under a pending disconnection notice.
- The enrollment window is a calendar window by month and day; the Winter Protection Plan accepts enrollment from November 1 through March 31, both days included, and every other kind at any time of the year.
- Self-service enrollment refers to the customer enrolling through online self-service without an agent; the kinds marked "No" are set up through an agent.

## Illustrations (hypothetical customers)

| Hypothetical customer | Kinds the class and bases in this schedule leave open |
|---|---|
| Business customer, agreement started 4 months ago | Payment Extension only (the Commercial Deferred Payment Agreement needs 6 months) |
| Residential customer aged 67, electric space heating, enrolling on December 10 | The Winter Protection Plan among others |
| Residential customer aged 67, gas space heating | Not the Winter Protection Plan |
| Residential customer with a current income qualification, oldest unpaid bill 60 days past due | Not the Arrearage Management Program (90 days required) |
